subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'Unworthy' from the given sentence.**

Unethical behaviour like saying mean or nasty things, is intolerable to a noble person
solution:
The correct answer is "Noble."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 

__
 
• The word **"unworthy"** means not deserving respect or attention. (सम्मान या ध्यान के योग्य नहीं)

 
 
• **Example**:* I put all **unworthy**__ thoughts out of my mind.*
 
 
 
• So, the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word **'Unworthy' **from the given sentence is **"Noble."**
 
• "Noble" means honest; full of courage and care for others. (ईमानदार; साहसी और परोपकारी)
 __
 
• Example: *It was a **noble**__ effort to achieve a peaceful settlement to the conflict.*
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Unethical: **not conforming to a high moral standard. (उच्च नैतिक मानक के अनुरूप नहीं)
 
• **Nasty: **very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा या अप्रिय)
 
• **Intolerable: **too bad, unpleasant or difficult to bear or accept. (इतना ख़राब; बुरा या कठिन कि सहन या स्‍वीकार न हो सके; असह्य, असहनीय, बर्दाशत से बाहर)
